events.prompt: Late autumn afternoon in an old sandstone arcade beside a courtyard. A 25-year-old adult Japanese woman stands in a band of low, hard sunlight between two arches and turns her face toward the sun on the left, eyes softly half-closed, with a calm, private half-smile; her body is angled toward the light, one shoulder resting against a sandstone column, one hand loosely holding the edge of her coat at her chest. She has natural fair, cool-toned skin, an oval face with long narrow eyes and a straight nose, a clean base with precise eyeliner and a muted rose-red lip, and long deep wine-red brown hair in a loose, soft low chignon with a few strands framing her face. Curvy figure, 166 cm tall, bust 92 cm, waist 58 cm, hips 90 cm, F cup, a slim waist. She wears a black fine-knit square-neck midi dress, a camel wool coat draped over her shoulders with her arms out of the sleeves, and small gold hoop earrings. Light: the sun lays a warm band across her face, neck and shoulders, so her face is the focal point of the picture, its highlights keeping their detail, with crisp natural shadows; the sunlit floor bounces a little warm light into the shade. Setting: plain walls with no signs, a few yellow leaves, nobody else around; on the left behind her, a row of round arches recedes into cool shade striped with sunlight. Shot: knee-up, from a little above her head to just above her knees; her feet are out of the frame. Camera: vertical 3:4, at her chest height, a 50mm lens from about 2 metres, natural perspective with straight vertical lines. Composition: she stands slightly right of centre and fills most of the frame height; the column is only a narrow strip of shaded stone at the right edge, partly cut off by the frame, so it frames her without drawing the eye. Colours: black, camel, sandstone gold and the wine-red of her hair. Natural skin texture with visible pores, believable light that belongs to the scene, refined colour grading.
